name: read_clipboard
summary: Read the current text on the macOS clipboard (what a paste would produce). Returns plain text only. Note: the clipboard often holds sensitive data — a password manager copies passwords here, for example — so treat whatever comes back as potentially secret.

name: write_clipboard
summary: Replace the macOS clipboard with the given text (as if the user had copied it). Runs immediately; undo restores whatever text was on the clipboard before — unless the prior contents were non-text or too large to hold, in which case there is nothing to restore to and the preview says so.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to place on the clipboard (max 1 MiB). Delivered verbatim as data — never parsed as flags or code.
